conclusion: Cost result holds at scale: hit ratio 0.15% -> 80.4%, billed input per task 77,113 -> 21,436 (-72%) on 400 unseen questions, same in every block.
No statistically significant answer-quality change on the 400 new questions: paired F1 -0.034, 95% CI [-0.080, +0.011]; a drop of up to about 0.08 cannot be excluded. EM 0.352 -> 0.291.
Pooled with the 45 questions that raised the concern: -0.045, CI [-0.088, -0.002]; that sample is biased toward a drop because it prompted the check.
Run-to-run noise on 45 questions is of the same size: re-running the after arm moved F1 by +0.059 (CI [-0.032, +0.158]); block means on the new 400 range from -0.12 to +0.02.

Where the loss sits: 15 questions switched from answered to 'sources do not ...' (-0.056 of the mean) against 11 the other way (+0.025); abstention count unchanged (47 -> 47). Format changes roughly cancel. Context compaction never triggered, so the compaction stub is not a cause.
